authors: TG, BandaStation and Primera contributors (source artwork)
Junkkky (art direction)
StationTrauma contributors (native-grid adaptations)
assets.changes: Five native 480x480 planet-only layers adapted directly from existing parallax artwork. Frozen retains icemoon exactly; barren, arid and lush adapt its pixel patterns with palette changes, craters and continents. Lava retains the native planet body, removes moon/debris, restores occluded pixels and cleans its five-color palette. No resizing or realistic texture synthesis. Source cosmic DMI remains unchanged.
